# test/e2e

End-to-end validation of `git-lanes` CLI interface contracts occurs in `cli.test.ts` via `runCLI`. `cli.test.ts` asserts `exitCode` and output streams against isolated environments managed by `createTempRepo` and `removeTempRepo`.

## Contents

- [cli.test.ts](./cli.test.ts) groups 8 tests within `describe("CLI commands")` verifying `help`, `version`, `list`, `start`, and `commit` behaviors.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `help` and `--help` flags require `exitCode` 0 with `stdout` containing "git-lanes", "USAGE", and "SESSION COMMANDS".
- `version` and `--version` flags require `exitCode` 0 with `stdout` containing "git-lanes".
- Unknown commands trigger `exitCode` 1.
- `list` without sessions returns `exitCode` 0 with `stderr` containing "No active sessions".
- `start` without name argument and `commit` without message argument both enforce `exitCode` 1.

## Test Dependencies

- `runCLI` from [../helpers/capture.ts](../helpers/capture.ts) captures `{exitCode, stdout, stderr}`.
- `createTempRepo` and `removeTempRepo` from [../helpers/temp-repo.ts](../helpers/temp-repo.ts) manage lifecycle isolation.

## Conventions

- Assertions utilize `expect(result.exitCode).toBe(0|1)` and `toContain` for stream validation.
- Bun test framework executes suites as configured in `bunfig.toml`.
